items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Of course, she was called a woman Pat King... She was almost as big as a little white.

ctx.x: Yeah, she was almost as big as a little white. But she was on Gascot and Villery, on the corner of Gascot and Villery at that time. Of course, she was called a woman Pat King.
You're where Larry and Katz is now in that neighborhood.
